title: Measure whether raising the launcher's Rust test-thread cap shortens a full gate on many-core hosts
outcome: We know whether the launcher's fixed 8 Rust test threads is what keeps a DL560 (144-core) full gate at the same speed as Central, and what thread setting, if any, to use per host.
acceptance: On DL560, two measurement runs of the same clean master with the Rust test-thread setting at 8 (the default) and at a higher value (for example 32) report their rust stage times, total time and peak RAM, as author evidence only
Any failure that appears only at the higher setting is filed as its own item with its test name, never hidden by lowering the setting
The result and a recommendation (keep 8, or a per-host setting) are recorded on this item and reported to Greg
